about:
Charleston Steel operates from Dunbar, West Virginia, where it has been supplying steel to the construction industry since 1989. The company is led by President John E. Goetz IV and has accumulated over 34 years of fabrication experience.

The shop functions as a full‑service structural steel fabricator and value‑added steel service center. Its core output includes fabricated structural steel, joists and deck, stairs and handrail, simple bridges and bridge components, as well as material‑handling and heavy‑duty weighing equipment. The facility holds AISC certification and AWS Certified Welding Fabricator status, with welding procedures covering all joints, processes and positions.

Customers span commercial and industrial construction, the material‑handling and weighing sectors, and state departments of highways for bridge work. The company’s central West Virginia location provides interstate access to East Coast shipping ports.

Charleston Steel emphasizes a customer‑oriented philosophy built on competitive pricing, on‑time delivery and a quality system audited annually by Quality Management Company, LLC. Its AISC and AWS certifications underscore a commitment to consistent, documented fabrication standards.
